确认后可填写颜色名称，也可以直接使用色值作为名称。: Give the color a name, or use its hex code as the name.
纯色只能选择一种颜色: Choose just one color for a solid-color item.
自然站立，软尺绕膝盖中部一整圈，不要勒紧。: Stand naturally and measure around the middle of your knee without pulling the tape tight.
自然站立，软尺绕自然腰线一整圈。: Stand naturally and measure all the way around your natural waist.
衣橱已完整恢复，原有衣橱保留: Wardrobe restored. Your existing wardrobes have been kept.
裁剪失败，请重试: Could not crop the photo. Please try again.
裁剪结果超过 20 MB，请缩小裁剪范围。原图未改变。: The cropped image exceeds 20 MB. Try a smaller crop. Your original photo is unchanged.
要去哪里？穿起来感觉怎么样？: Where did you go? How did it feel to wear?
解除配对后，本机资料保留；未确认的同步将在下次配对时重新核对。电脑上的设备授权可: Your local data will be kept. Any unconfirmed sync will be checked when you pair again. You can revoke this device's access on your computer.
记录不存在于授权衣橱: This record is not in the authorized wardrobe.
记录同时存在于资料和删除清单: A record cannot be present in both the data and the deletion list.
记录身体尺寸，单位为 cm。所有项目可留空，围度填写一整圈。: Record your body measurements in cm. Every field is optional. Measure circumferences all the way around.
记录过大，请分开导入: These records exceed the size limit. Import them in smaller batches.
试试其他分类，或清空筛选条件。: Try another category or clear your filters.
请先添加单品照片，再从照片取色。: Add an item photo before picking a color from it.
请先选择主色或要保留的颜色: Choose a main color or the color you want to keep.
请先配置模型服务: Set up a model service first.
请拍照或导入一张搭配照片: Take or import an outfit photo.
请添加搭配照片或选择单品: Add outfit photos or choose items.
请添加搭配照片或选择至少一件单品: Add outfit photos or choose at least one item.
请点击照片范围内的颜色。: Choose a color within the photo.
请输入 HTTPS 服务地址；本机模型可使用 HTTP 地址: Enter an HTTPS API base URL. Local models may use HTTP.
请输入有效的局域网电脑地址: Enter a valid computer address on your local network.
请输入有效的模型服务地址: Enter a valid model service URL.
请输入电脑服务地址，例如 http://192.168.1.10:4320: Enter your computer's server address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:4320.
请选择 JPG、PNG、WebP、GIF 或 AVIF 图片: Choose a JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, or AVIF image.
请选择主色，其余颜色作为辅色。: Choose a main color. The remaining colors will be accents.
请选择已有搭配或添加新搭配照片: Choose a saved outfit or add photos for a new one.
账号列表读取失败，请重试: Could not load profiles. Please try again.
账号名称不能超过 100 个字符: Profile names must be 100 characters or fewer.
账号已切换，请重新载入: The profile has changed. Please reload.
账号已在其他标签页切换，草稿仍保留。请重新载入当前账号。: The profile was switched in another tab. Your draft is still here. Reload to use the current profile.
账号操作失败，请重试: Could not update the profile. Please try again.
账号资料过大，请拆分账号: This profile's data exceeds the size limit. Split it into smaller profiles.
赤脚站直，从头顶量到脚底。: Stand straight without shoes and measure from the top of your head to the floor.
赤脚站立，从脚跟量到最长脚趾；两脚不同时参考较长的一只。: Stand barefoot and measure from your heel to your longest toe. If your feet differ in length, use the longer measurement.
软尺水平绕胸部最丰满处一整圈。: Keep the tape level and measure around the fullest part of your chest.
软尺水平绕臀部最丰满处一整圈。: Keep the tape level and measure around the fullest part of your hips.
软尺绕大腿最丰满处一整圈。: Measure around the fullest part of your thigh.
载入当前账号前放弃草稿？: Discard your draft and load the current profile?
输入品牌或选择已填品牌: Enter a brand or choose one you've used
输入或搜索颜色: Enter or search for a color
还没有搭配，可以切换到「照片新搭配」直接保存穿搭照。: No outfits yet. Choose “New outfit from photo” to save an outfit photo directly.
还没有衣橱单品，也可以直接保存照片搭配。: No wardrobe items yet. You can still save an outfit using photos.
这一天，还留着空白。: Nothing planned for this day yet.
这一条记录和快照将被删除，衣橱单品和原搭配会保留。: This entry and its snapshot will be deleted. Your wardrobe items and the original outfit will be kept.
这个分类里还没有单品。: No items in this category yet.
这会替换当前未保存的草稿。已保存的尺码资料保留。: This will replace your unsaved draft. Saved measurements will be kept.
这次想怎么穿？: What would you like to wear?
这里保留着保存时的照片与单品快照。: These are the photos and items as they were when you saved this look.
这里是透明区域，请选择照片中有颜色的位置。: This area is transparent. Choose a colored area of the photo.
连接中断，未收到完整回答，请重试: The connection was lost before the response finished. Please try again.
连接中断，请检查网络后重试: Connection lost. Check your network and try again.
选择年份，再点击要查看的月份。: Choose a year, then select a month.
选择支持工具调用的模型；查看照片还需要模型支持视觉。密钥仅在电脑服务保存。: Choose a model that supports tools. To view photos, it also needs vision support. Your key is stored only on the computer server.
选择要保留的颜色；切回其他模式可恢复其余颜色。: Choose the color to keep. Switch back to another mode to restore the others.
配对码错误或已过期，请在电脑上重新生成: The pairing code is incorrect or expired. Generate a new one on your computer.
重复提交内容不一致: A repeated submission contains different data.
需保留读取资料权限，权限不能重复: Read permission is required, and permissions must not be duplicated.
鞋码和合脚程度仅适用于鞋履: Shoe sizes and shoe fit apply only to shoes.
颜色名称不能超过 50 个字符: Color names must be 50 characters or fewer.
首次同步时，双方已有资料保留为两个衣橱；空手机衣橱直接接入电脑衣橱。: On first sync, existing data on each device stays in separate wardrobes. An empty phone wardrobe connects directly to the computer's wardrobe.
首次配置或更换服务地址时，请填写 API Key；无密钥的本机服务可填写 loc: Enter an API key when setting up or changing a service. For a local service without a key, enter local.
首版只支持局域网地址: Only local network addresses are supported.
首版支持 2 GB / 2000 条记录以内的备份: Backups support up to 2 GB and 2,000 records.
首版支持 2 GB 以内的备份包: Backups must be 2 GB or smaller.
